name: CleanSeaNet 2021_83_1
subtitle: Baie de Seine, off Le Havre

reported.note: Length and area are values reported in the alert record. They were not measured by any model in this system, and no geometry backs them.

attributionRationale: The event record's own feedback is 'Nothing observed' and no slick polygon was recovered, so the detection cannot be corroborated. The ranking is reported as a possible-source hypothesis, not a determination.

documentedPossibleSource.note: Identity revealed only after the blind ranking was frozen; never a ranking feature. This is a historical attribution proof-of-concept, not a legal finding.

coverage.label: Satellite scene
coverage.detail: The TerraSAR-X scene referenced by the alert was not recovered. The map shows the reported detection location over base imagery only.

coverage.label: Detection geometry
coverage.detail: Reported point only; no polygon recovered.

coverage.label: Probability raster
coverage.detail: No real prediction/probability GeoTIFF was recovered.

coverage.label: AIS
coverage.detail: Global Fishing Watch hourly 0.1-degree grid-cell centre presence observations. These are not raw AIS tracks: positions are snapped to cell centres and reported hourly, so apparent paths are stepped and speed and course over ground are unavailable at this resolution.

coverage.label: Currents
coverage.detail: 48.4% of grid cells carry no current value (land and product coverage gaps). Missing cells are drawn as voids, never as zero flow. Particles entering them were marked inactive by the drift model.
